description: Unit tests for the NtlmBufferReader class, testing buffer reading, parsing, and validation functions in the context of NTLM protocol message processing.

classes.name: NtlmBufferReader
classes.description: A class for reading and parsing NTLM protocol message buffers, supporting various data types and validation functions.

classes.name: SecurityBuffer
classes.description: A structure representing a security buffer with length and offset fields.

classes.name: TargetInfoAvId
classes.description: Enumeration of target info attribute IDs used in NTLM target info data.

classes.name: TargetInfoAvFlags
classes.description: Flags for target info attribute, such as MIC presence.

classes.name: MessageType
classes.description: Enumeration of NTLM message types (Negotiate, Challenge, Authenticate).

classes.name: AvPair
classes.description: Structure representing an attribute-value pair in target info data, including ID, length, and associated data.

methods.name: ReadSignature
methods.description: Checks if the buffer matches the NTLM signature.

methods.name: ReadMessageType
methods.description: Reads and validates the message type from the buffer.

methods.name: ReadTargetInfo
methods.description: Parses target info attribute-value pairs from the buffer.

methods.name: ReadTargetInfoPayload
methods.description: Reads the payload of target info data based on a security buffer.

methods.name: MatchSignature
methods.description: Checks if the buffer starts with the NTLM signature.

methods.name: MatchMessageHeader
methods.description: Checks if the buffer matches a specific message header with a given message type.

methods.name: MatchZeros
methods.description: Checks if the buffer consists entirely of zeros.

methods.name: MatchEmptySecurityBuffer
methods.description: Checks if the buffer contains an empty security buffer (all zeros).

methods.name: ReadAvPairHeader
methods.description: Reads the header of an attribute-value pair, extracting ID and length.
